name: Magical Kanan
source:
A magical creature went to the normal world to retrieve some seeds. He lost his power and fainted. A girl found him and took him home. Well, this creature became a man after gaining back his power, which surprised the girl some. An incident happened and she became a magical fighter with his kiss. Things start to get complicated as they try to get the seeds and with most people not being what they seem.

[From AniDB]
translation:
一个魔法生物为了取回一些种子，来到平凡的世界，却失去力量、昏倒在地。一名少女发现了它，将它带回家。重获力量后，它变成了一名男子，令少女颇为惊讶。后来发生的一件事中，他以一吻让少女成为魔法战士。随着两人设法取回种子，事情开始变得复杂起来，因为多数人都不像表面看上去那样简单。

[摘自AniDB]
